ekranHook: The fear that is mostly a myth

pencereler.0-5: Everyone fears the elevator suddenly plunging to the ground. In reality, it is one
pencereler.5-12: of the safest machines you will ever ride. Each elevator hangs from multiple steel cables, not one. Any single
pencereler.12-20: cable can hold the entire car by itself. If they ALL somehow snapped, a speed brake grips the rails. Springs at the
pencereler.20-30: bottom would cushion whatever was left. The famous free-fall elevator has basically never happened. The real risks are doors and getting stuck, not falling. Physics is quietly protecting

segmentler.metin: Everyone fears the elevator suddenly plunging to the ground.
It took only every cable snapping.
The answer is redundant ropes and an overspeed safety brake — and it is why redundancy makes free fall almost impossible.
